player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyi Player {player_id} ({piece}). Ɔkɔtɔni a ɔbɔ ne ho amo ni ({opp}). Mfa mmɔden ase sɛ '[b1 c3]' (fii → kɔ). Abɛde nyinaa dɔ so sɛ abɛde a ɔwɔ chess knight.
Bibini biara a wɔfa no hyɛ {score_per_capture} point. Agorɔ no awieɛ ɔkɔsi {max_moves} mmɔden anaa bere a ɔkɔtɔni biara wɔ mmɔden a wɔmfa anaa abɛde biara. Agorɔ a ɛso sen biara di nkonim.

invalid_move.not_your_piece: Ɛnyɛ w'adwuma ne sɛ wobɛkyerɛ baabi a efi.
invalid_move.own_piece: Wuntumi mfa wo ho nto fam.
